issues.detail: The Hebrew phrase 'מוֹצִאֵי דִבַּת הָאָרֶץ רָעָה' means 'those who brought out an evil report of the land' (i.e., the spies who gave a bad report about the land). The Chinese renders it as '那些在地裏尋找壞的毀謗的人' ('those who sought evil slander in the land'), which changes the meaning: the Hebrew says they 'brought out' (מוֹצִאֵי, from יָצָא, 'to go out/bring out') a report, not that they 'searched for' (尋找) slander. This alters the action and the nature of the offense.
